story: TinyVG – an alternative binary encoded vector graphics format
text: Support will vary by viewer, but Chrome's built-in PDF viewer supports a subset of Javascript. It's enough to play Breakout inside a PDF: [VIDEO]
the repo's < [LINK] > readme points to the talk given on this: [VIDEO] the 2021 submission of the repo got some lively commentary [LINK]

> PDF forms now support JavaScript embedded in PDF files. Some PDF forms use JavaScript for validation and other interactive features. As far as I can tell I still can't play breakout in a PDF in Firefox though (and I think that's for the better) [0] [LINK] [1] [VIDEO]
